title: Contract Fastpath: Compact Attestation Responses and Pricing Macros
creator: Maya Chen
description: Enable a lightweight, on-demand attestation payload format and a pricing macro that reduces legal review overhead for early-stage enterprise contracts. The goal is to surface a compact set of pre-validated SIG/CAIQ answers plus a configurable pricing credit that offsets answer effort for small-to-medium contracts, reducing sales cycle time without weakening compliance posture.
acceptance_criteria: Compact attestation package template (<= 12 pages equivalent) produced and stored in the answers library
Automated assembly flow in Console to generate compact package from selected answers within < 10 minutes
Pricing macro defined and wired into quote generator to apply a flat evidence credit for contracts under $100k ARR
A/B pilot with 5 sales deals shows median legal review time reduced by >= 30%
Security review sign-off process documented and security_review_required flag set for the flow
progress_updates: 2025-02-18: Kickoff with security, legal, and sales enablement. Agreed success metric: reduce time-to-sign by 2 weeks for qualifying deals.

2025-02-22: Draft compact template completed — removed non-essential CAIQ sections; held trade-off session with Security. Decision: keep encryption/KMS, SSO, and data-retention sections; stub low-risk items with canonical language.

2025-02-27: Engineering feasibility review: Console needs an "assemble attestation" API and a templating microservice. Scope reduced to Console flow + S3 storage for phase 1; Private deployment integration deferred.
2025-03-01: Pricing sync: finance approves experimental flat evidence credit of 5% of first-year contract value capped at $5k for invites processed through Fastpath.
2025-03-04: Built prototype in staging for generating compact packages from curated answers library. First internal trial with SalesOps scheduled 2025-03-10.
Pending: collect pilot metrics and iterate on template wording based on legal feedback.
